baits.name: Massa
baits.notes: Replaced after 10 minutes if no action. Used with a weight (Marine brand).

baits.name: Mafiche
baits.notes: Does not dissolve. Adjusted slightly after 10 minutes if no action.

baits.name: Salsicha
baits.notes: Left in the water for 15-40 minutes depending on the situation.

baits.name: Ficha
baits.notes: Used for 1-2 hours. Not typically used with weights.

baits.name: Sambiqueira
baits.notes: Used for 2-3 hours. Not typically used with weights.

baits.name: Ração de fundo
baits.notes: Used with a weight (Marine brand). Flavor changed after 1.5 hours if no action.

additional_notes: Bait rotation is recommended if there's no action after the specified duration.
Weights are used only for 'massa' and 'ração de fundo' (Marine brand).
The speaker emphasizes adjusting baits based on environmental conditions and fish behavior.
